meals.title: Eggs & toast
meals.recipe: Cook 2 eggs with 1 tsp oil. Serve with 2 slices of whole-wheat toast.

meals.title: Dal, bhindi & jeera rice
meals.recipe: Simmer moong dal with turmeric; finish with cumin, garlic and lemon. Cook bhindi in a wide pan. Serve with measured rice and plain high-protein yogurt.

meals.title: Yogurt, guava & almonds
meals.recipe: Each: 200 g unsweetened high-protein yogurt, 1 serving whole fruit and 15 g nuts or 25 g roasted chana. Check the yogurt label; ordinary curd has less protein.

meals.title: Tandoori chicken & mint raita
meals.recipe: Marinate skinless chicken in curd, ginger-garlic, Kashmiri chilli, garam masala and lemon for 30 minutes in the fridge. Air-fry at 190–200°C, turning halfway; start checking at 20 minutes and cook until the thickest meat reaches 74°C away from the bone. Serve with roti, kachumber and mint raita.

meals.title: Paneer bhurji & phulkas
meals.recipe: Soften onion, tomato, ginger and cumin. Fold in crumbled lower-fat paneer and peas. Finish with coriander; serve with phulkas and cucumber.

meals.title: Mango yogurt & roasted chana
meals.recipe: Each: 200 g unsweetened high-protein yogurt, 1 serving whole fruit and 15 g nuts or 25 g roasted chana. Check the yogurt label; ordinary curd has less protein.

meals.title: Chicken saag & rice
meals.recipe: Cook garlic, ginger, onion and cumin; add chicken and blended spinach. Simmer until chicken reaches 74°C. Finish with lemon and a spoon of curd. Serve measured rice and roasted cauliflower.

meals.title: Rajma rice & crunchy cabbage
meals.recipe: Soak rajma overnight, drain and boil vigorously in fresh water for at least 30 minutes before simmering until fully soft. Add cooked tomato masala. Serve with rice, cabbage and high-protein yogurt.

meals.title: Apple, yogurt & walnuts
meals.recipe: Each: 200 g unsweetened high-protein yogurt, 1 serving whole fruit and 15 g nuts or 25 g roasted chana. Check the yogurt label; ordinary curd has less protein.

meals.title: Hariyali tikka & peppers
meals.recipe: Blend mint, coriander, curd, chilli, garlic and lemon. Marinate chicken in the fridge, then air-fry with peppers and onions until chicken reaches 74°C. Serve with roti and yogurt dip.

meals.title: Homestyle chicken curry
meals.recipe: Cook onion-tomato masala with ginger, garlic and whole spices. Add chicken and simmer until cooked through to 74°C. Serve with rice and green beans.

meals.title: Soy keema & soft phulkas
meals.recipe: Boil dry soy chunks according to packet instructions, squeeze and chop. Cook with onion-tomato masala, peas and keema spices. Serve with phulkas and cucumber raita.

meals.title: Dal palak & paneer tikka
meals.recipe: Cook lentils with spinach. Marinate lower-fat paneer with curd, chilli, cumin and lemon; air-fry until golden. Serve with measured rice.

meals.title: Pepper chicken & vegetables
meals.recipe: Toast crushed pepper, curry leaves and cumin in measured oil. Add ginger-garlic and chicken; cook to 74°C. Finish with lemon. Serve roti, sautéed vegetables and curd.

meals.title: Chole, phulkas & kachumber
meals.recipe: Simmer fully cooked chickpeas in onion-tomato masala with chole spice. Finish with amchur. Serve with phulkas, chopped salad and high-protein yogurt.

meals.title: Chicken shawarma wraps
meals.recipe: Season chicken with cumin, paprika, garlic, lemon and curd. Air-fry to 74°C and slice. Wrap in phulkas with shredded cabbage, cucumber and garlic-yogurt sauce.

meals.title: Chicken & vegetable pulao
meals.recipe: Cook chicken with whole spices, measured rice and plenty of vegetables. Check chicken reaches 74°C. Divide rice and edible meat evenly; serve cucumber raita.

meals.title: Palak paneer & phulkas
meals.recipe: Blanch spinach and blend roughly. Cook garlic, onion, tomato and cumin in measured oil. Add spinach and lower-fat paneer, then simmer briefly. Serve phulkas and fresh salad.
